titles.title: Small Business Audit Correction Act of 2026
Small Business Audit Correction Act of 2026

A bill to amend the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 to exclude the audits of privately held, non-carrying brokers and dealers that are in good standing from certain requirements under title I of that Act, and for other purposes.
